item.description: Good morning, Sydney! Happy Friday, May 1st, 2026, and a huge welcome back to your Daily Drive. We're looking at another gorgeous autumn day here, perfect for that morning commute or an early stroll before the weekend kicks in, with local news buzzing about the upcoming festivals. Did you know that today marks the traditional start of winter in the northern hemisphere – quite the contrast to our beautiful Sydney autumn! Here's to a fantastic start to your Friday, let's make it a great one!
